scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p ../dist dist/node_modules && rm -rf ../dist/get_recipes.zip && cp -rL ../../../node_modules/@aws-sdk dist/node_modules/ 2>/dev/null || true && find dist/node_modules -type d \( -name 'test*' -o -name 'dist-es' -o -name 'dist-types' \) -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && find dist/node_modules -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.map' -o -name 'LICENSE*' -o -name '*.d.ts' \) -delete 2>/dev/null || true && cd dist && zip -r ../../dist/get_recipes.zip . -x '*.map' -x 'get_recipes.zip'
